trailhead.label: Ströden car park (1,400 m), Prägraten am Großvenediger, the board’s start

cautions: Parts of this walk are exposed; keep your dog close and on a short lead.
Viewing platforms high above the gorge and right by the water: keep your dog on a short lead.
Steep wooden and stone steps beside the cascades.
The glacial Isel is fast and cold, especially on summer afternoons: keep your dog out of it.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
